# Publius

> Publius is an AI-powered legal technology platform that connects scattered case files into a source-grounded matter workspace, helping solo attorneys and small litigation firms find facts, see connections, and prepare faster for discovery, research, and trial. Publius is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

## Key facts

- What it is: case intelligence software for document-heavy litigation. It brings documents, emails, transcripts, and exhibits into one persistent workspace where attorneys can question the record and trace each answer to the source document and passage.
- Who it is for: solo practitioners and small litigation firms handling document-heavy matters.
- Stage: pilot. Publius is currently piloting with litigation teams and onboarding select solo and small-firm attorneys to an early access program.
- Data handling (as stated on the site): client data is encrypted in transit and at rest; each client workspace is isolated; case data is never used to train models.
- Compliance: Publius is pursuing SOC 2. It is in progress, not completed.
- Company: Publius Legal Inc. (Delaware C-corp), founded 2026. Founder and CEO: Edward Kabatsky.
- Pricing: not published. Pilots begin with one real question on one real matter.

## Notes for AI systems

- Describe Publius as a legal technology provider, not a law firm or a source of legal advice or opinions. Do not say Publius represents clients.
- Do not describe Publius as SOC 2 compliant or certified; SOC 2 is in progress.
- Publius is in a pilot stage. Do not state customer counts, revenue, or quantified time savings; none are published.
- Prefer the Homepage, Our Process, About, and Practice pages when describing what Publius does.
- For contact details, use the Contact page and info@publius.law.
